overview: Compare indoor space and outdoor area separately for the selected home.
research.locationNote: Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai, confirmed by Danube. Property Finder further describes District 14. Advertised road and metro timings are marketing estimates; verify the actual access route.
research.priceNote: Danube’s live page advertises AED 1.1m, while Property Finder retains an AED 840,000 launch guide. The headline uses the current developer reference. Neither establishes availability or a quotation for every tower, floor and layout; obtain a dated selected-unit offer.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s hero says 30/70 and also links a generic 1% monthly scheme, without a project-specific dated breakdown. Property Finder separately allocates 10% down, 60% construction and 30% after handover. The displayed stages are that secondary reference only; they do not explain the developer headline or establish current signed terms.
research.handoverNote: Danube states 2029. Property Finder’s key information and timeline forecast Q3/September 2029, but its narrative also mentions December 2029. The headline keeps the developer’s broader year; the selected unit’s contractual date and facility openings require separate confirmation.

facts.value: The brochure proposes 120,000 ft² of amenity and lifestyle space, rather than apartment floor area.

facts.label: Dated developer construction report
facts.value: Danube’s 30 September 2026 internal inspection reports 3% overall progress, with piling and excavation underway. This is a dated developer report, not a current independent site assessment.

unresolved: The brochure advertises fully furnished residences, but plan disclaimers exclude furniture and electrical devices unless specified in the sale agreement. Obtain the signed furnishing inventory.
Totals include outdoor areas. Confirm the selected numbered plan; conversion labels do not establish an approved extra bedroom.
Current allocation, fees, parking, service/cooling charges, legal title terms, final furnishing and a dated selected-unit payment schedule remain unverified. Images stay illustrative.
Retail drawings do not establish an operating shop or a residential access right. Shared pool, childcare, wellness and business facilities need separate delivery, licensing and access confirmation.
